paragraphs: In [Bava Kamma 80b (Hyman cites 80a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.80b.9): Rabbi Acha bar Pappa said in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Pappa, in the name of Rabbi Ada bar Pappa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The chain Acha bar Pappa — Abba bar Pappa — Ada bar Pappa appears in the William Davidson digital text of Bava Kamma 80b. Hyman’s supplied locator is 80a, retained in the translation.

The first chain in the linked passage is Acha bar Pappa transmitting in Abba bar Pappa’s name, and Abba in Ada’s name. Two competing chains follow. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=237&lang=en) cites the Abba-to-Ada link.
